subjects.name: Escape to Hell and Other Stories

summary: Muammar Gaddafi seized Libya in a bumbling 1969 officers' coup and ruled for four decades through his Green Book ideology, televised executions, sexual abuse of girls, sponsorship of terrorism and assassinations abroad, until rebels killed him in 2011.

evidence.note: birth given as 1941 or 1943 in tents near Sirte; date uncertain
Italian invasion and camps covered as background to his childhood, not counted in span
cadet allegedly executed for being gay at the military academy
September 1969 coup and its chaotic execution narrated at length
Green Book and its system of people's congresses described in detail
1984 London embassy shooting kills a British policewoman
abduction and rape of schoolgirls and boys reported from BBC documentary
Amazonian bodyguard unit, largely press-ganged, segment begins
funding of IRA, ETA, Red Brigades and other militant groups
Lockerbie bombing over Scotland linked to Libya
full reading of the short story Suicide of the Astronaut
2009 New York UN trip and tent on a Trump estate in Westchester

notes: Birth year is uncertain (transcript says 1941 or 1943); 1942 used as the commonly cited year, hence approximate. Post-2011 Libya is a short coda, so reaches_present is false. Sexual abuse material is about two minutes but explicit and central to the title, so both abuse themes and warnings are kept.
